problem_text:
A maritime logistics firm must devise a procurement and storage strategy for a vital fuel additive over a voyage schedule spanning 17 consecutive ports of call.  
The initial stockpile of the additive at the outset of the voyage is 53 barrels.  
At each port call \( t = 1, \dots, 17 \), the supplier permits the firm to request a shipment whose volume must be between 11 and 31 barrels.  
However, every shipment requested will undergo a 3‑day transit delay before it becomes available for consumption or replenishing the onboard reserve.  
The additive requirement at each port is as follows:  
* Port 1: requires 51 barrels  
* Port 2: requires 44 barrels  
* Port 3: requires 58 barrels  
* Port 4: requires 22 barrels  
* Port 5: requires 39 barrels  
* Port 6: requires 44 barrels  
* Port 7: requires 52 barrels  
* Port 8: requires 38 barrels  
* Port 9: requires 47 barrels  
* Port 10: requires 49 barrels  
* Port 11: requires 31 barrels  
* Port 12: requires 32 barrels  
* Port 13: requires 33 barrels  
* Port 14: requires 17 barrels  
* Port 15: requires 59 barrels  
* Port 16: requires 60 barrels  
* Port 17: requires 11 barrels  

Consumption shortfalls are tolerated, but any unsatisfied requirement is simply lost and will not be carried forward.  
Throughout the voyage, additive quantities may be fractional, and the total volume of additive stored onboard at any moment must not surpass the tank capacity of 57 barrels.  

At the first port, the maximum allowable shipment volume is 17 barrels.  
By the time the vessel reaches port 16, the onboard reserve must be no less than 26 barrels.  

The overall voyage expense comprises three elements: the procurement cost, amounting to 2 per barrel ordered; the storage cost, amounting to 3 per barrel kept in the tanks from one port to the next; and the penalty for unmet demand, amounting to 12 per barrel of unsatisfied requirement.  
Determine the optimal shipment volume to request at each port and monitor the ensuing stockpile and shortage levels so as to minimize the total voyage expense.
